title: Flight controller profiles
summary: Editable flight mappings and legacy controller preference migration.

blocks.text: Provides input.flight-profiles@1.0.0 without loading any gamepad device code. No required services. Browser and offline environments; platform authority only.

Owns the original standard button/axis defaults, validated per-player profiles and migration from space-sim:gamepad:v1. Device sampling remains a separate optional package. Local preferences do not change authoritative simulation identity.

The codec owns no listeners or devices. Consumers retain their independent profile state; disabling this provider is rejected while a required consumer remains selected. Replace with a compatible codec through prepare/activate/dispose.

Unpack, edit source, rebuild/repack and import into a compatible game. Downloaded code requires explicit consent and has full application privileges. Building a package does not establish runtime acceptance.
